name: Blueprint
summary: A feature grid on blueprint paper: line drawings draw themselves and tiles open into detail sheets
about: A features section drawn like a technical sheet, on drafting paper in light mode and cobalt blueprint in dark mode. Each tile shows a dashed construction sketch; point at it and the solid line draws itself, hatching fills in, crop marks pull in and a dimension line measures the feature. Click a tile and a detail sheet grows out of it with a larger drawing, specs and a number that counts up.
how: Point at a tile (or tab to it): the drawing traces itself, hatching fills in and the dimension line opens with its value.
Each drawing then moves in its own way: the receipt prints, the lock snaps shut, the bell rings, the bars grow.
Click or press Enter on a tile: a scan line sweeps as the detail sheet grows out of the tile.
Read the specs while the large drawing traces itself and the stat counts up, then press Close or Escape to fold it back.
